[Academy](../codex/places.md#academy)

## Appearance

Gilbert Blythe is a tall boy with curly brown hair and a splendid chin. He features roguish hazel eyes that can carry a half-shy, half-eager expression, and his mouth is often twisted into a teasing smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. ## Personality

Gilbert Blythe is a clever, good-natured, and teasing young fellow who possesses his own strong opinions on life. He is skilled academically, notably serving as the head of the spelling class. Driven by personal ambition, he is determined to get the best out of life, put the best into it, and earn his own way through college.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## History

After spending a summer visiting cousins in [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), Gilbert Blythe returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, where he immediately antagonized [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her hair, sparking a intense, years-long academic rivalry. Despite his initial attempt to apologize, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) fiercely ignored him, continuing to ignore his presence during school functions even after he rescued her from a sinking boat on the pond and offered friendship once more. Their competition persisted through their shared studies for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations and their subsequent time at the academy, where Gilbert won the coveted medal while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) earned the Avery scholarship. Upon returning home, Gilbert gave up his secured position as the teacher at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could take the job and remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following Matthew's death. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learned of his sacrifice, she met him on the road, where the pair officially ended their grudge and became close friends.

> "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and Anne's relationship began on a hostile note when Gilbert pulled her red braid and called her 'Carrots' on his first day back at school, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head. Though Gilbert tried to apologize immediately afterward and made further attempts to reconcile, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejected him and swore a fierce, cold grudge against him. This lingering enmity transformed into an intense academic rivalry, driving both of them to excel in their studies as they constantly compete for the top position in class.

- Enemy of — intense rivalry and hostility after he teased her about her hair  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P51](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0051), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
